Introducing Assal Marathi Pickles, a celebration of authentic Marathi flavours that transport you to the vibrant streets of Maharashtra, the land of the great Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Immerse yourself in the rich tradition with three irresistible variants - Mango Pickle, Mixed Pickle, and Green Chilli Pickle. Crafted with precision, our pickles showcase a medley of fruits & vegetable pieces infused with a blend of aromatic spices.
Experience the true essence of Marathi cuisine, free from added sugar, trans fat, and cholesterol. These pickles are a tribute to the spirited Marathi culture, preserving the legacy of bold, tangy, and fiery flavours that define Maharashtra's culinary heritage. Assal Marathi - Real Marathi, Real Flavour!

details.description: NILON'S Fusilli Pasta is delicious and flavorful, the perfect Italian twist on things. Enjoy the authentic Italian taste in the comfort of your house. Nilon's Fusilli pasta is the perfect partner for any dish you can think of. Packed with flavour and perfect in shape to deliver a tasty bite, this Italian pasta is sure to satisfy all your needs. Enjoy this pasta as a morning or a midnight snack, it is perfect for all times. Explore more delicious and flavoursome pasta like these from Nilon's, available here at Big Basket.
details.ingredients: Wheat Semolina
details.usageInstructions:
1. Boil 2 cups of water, add pasta, 1 tbsp salt and oil.
2. Strain the cooked pasta and keep it aside.
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil, add vegetables of your choice and saute for 1-2 minutes.
4. Add tomato ketchup, pre-cooked pasta and spices of your choice, and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
5. Garnish with chopped onion and serve hot.
Pro tip - Use Nilon's Pasta Masala instead of spices and garnish with shredded cheese for a mouthwatering dish.
